title: phegopteris angelicifolia
intro: Phegopteris angelicifolia, commonly known as Angel Hair or Golden Maidenhair, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, as well as its use as an antidote for snake venom. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris angelicifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiviral properties, which are thought to be caused by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the full range of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
